label: Every favouring of an actual root has the value order as its formal object
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: for every actual root r at w and every favouring profile phi such that the favouring determination of phi is a real determination of r, the formal object of phi (the ranking that measures its kind of operation) is the value order v's relation v.better (STANDARD_OF_FAVOURING_1, the type ValueStandardOrder). In words: an actual root's favouring is measured by the good, not by an end content. It says nothing about whether that favouring is a natural or a rational appetite. A rational appetite meets it under the kind rule that the object of willing is the good (rationalKindGivesObject, Lean-only); a natural appetite whose nature's end is the good meets it as well (formalObjectControls row 1 with no apprehension). Lane 2b's D-directed nature, whose formal object is D-realization, denies it.
